payload.title: Enable all podcast extract modes on edited multicam timelines with strict selection scope
acceptance: All three podcast modes work on edited multicam timelines including overlay video/audio and many cuts.
No selection uses the whole active scene timeline; explicit clip selection restricts source dialogue and extraction to selected timeline spans, including synchronized camera/audio routes.
Canonical runtime owns scope derivation, validation and append-only extraction; source scenes/captions/full transcript/prior outputs remain intact.
Regression tests cover whole timeline versus sparse selections, overlapping cameras, chronological order, contextual reads and prohibited unselected moments; deploy verified local production.
